claim: Interpretability measurements can return plausible numbers from broken instruments; positive-control ladders, orthogonal certification, power analysis, and commitment-referenced depth are proposed as protocol.
stance_target: F: instrument-validation language exists for interpretability probes, not for confidence estimators
scope_conditions: Abstract; four open-weight models, refusal and moral representation
quoted_support: These measurements fail in specific, diagnosable ways that return a plausible number instead of an error, so a broken instrument can easily read as a finding.
